bubbles.title: Required ids
bubbles.hint: model.ts: Track.nextId and Bubble.id required. Every track already has them and legacy compat is dropped (review-fixes). New tracks start nextId: 1 (create/init/fork/diverge in cli/tracks.ts); ensureId becomes a plain 'take next id' at add/insert; drop the 'b.id === undefined' paths; update tests

bubbles.title: Named track types
bubbles.hint: model.ts: extract Handoff {note, at} and Closed {at} interfaces. parent/origin can't both be set: make Track a union (forked: parent, no origin | diverged: origin, no parent | neither) via ?: never — JSON format unchanged

bubbles.title: Drop active state
bubbles.hint: Leftover: BubbleState in model.ts still has 'active' and render.ts symbolFor checks bubble.state === 'active'; the active bubble is computed (activeIndex = first not done), never stored. Remove 'active' from BubbleState and render (keep the 'active' symbol key, it's the computed ◐). Check site machine + tests; old files with state 'active' would then be invalid: decide migrate to todo on load or reject (ties into Strict loadTrack)
